content: When results aren't immediate, doubt inevitably creeps in. We live in a culture conditioned for instant feedback, making long-horizon efforts feel unsettling. Remember: doubts are byproducts of doing meaningful work whose payoff takes time to compound. Focus on the inputs, trust the process, and let the timeline unfold.
Doubt doesn't mean you made the wrong move. It just means you took an action whose results haven't shown up yet. Keep building.
